instrument: Oklahoma HB 2992, Data Center Consumer Ratepayer Protection Act
summary: Creates a large-load class at 75 MW or more and imposes a $1,500-per-day penalty for failing to notify nearby landowners and officials within 60 days of a land purchase.
notes: Signed May 11 2026 per the Cherokee Nation task force report; a cited Oklahoma Voice piece is dated April 21. Pull the enrolled bill. Covers new data centers, crypto mining and AI computing facilities adding load after July 1, 2026; excludes entities building behind-the-meter generation. Attestation required before inauguration.
